items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn's Button primitive — variants (default/secondary/outline/ghost/link/destructive) and sizes (sm/default/lg/icon), with Craftled styling: border + ring + drop shadow for default/destructive, elevated shadow + ring on outline.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn's latest Card primitive — Card + CardHeader + CardTitle + CardDescription + CardAction + CardContent + CardFooter. Uses container queries on the header so CardAction auto-positions to the right when present. data-slot=* on every sub-component for downstream styling hooks.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Form input with Craftled treatment: ring-1 ring-foreground/10 + shadow-sm at rest, multi-layer focus ring (border-foreground/35 + ring-ring/25 at 3px), branded selection color, aria-invalid styling.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible form label built on @radix-ui/react-label. Auto-dims when paired with a disabled peer or inside a disabled group.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider built on @radix-ui/react-separator. Uses data-orientation to switch axis; decorative by default so screen readers skip it.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder. animate-pulse + bg-accent + rounded-md baked in. Compose any shape by sizing it with width/height/rounded utilities.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog built on @radix-ui/react-dialog. Includes overlay, content, header, footer, title, description, and an opt-out closable X. data-slot=* hooks on every sub-component for styling integration.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Full dropdown menu surface built on @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu: items, checkbox items, radio groups, labels, separators, shortcuts, and nested sub-menus. Includes a destructive item variant.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Accessible tabs built on @radix-ui/react-tabs. TabsList wraps TabsTrigger pills; active triggers get a bg-background lift with shadow.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip built on @radix-ui/react-tooltip. Includes TooltipProvider so you can drop a single root once and use Tooltip + TooltipTrigger + TooltipContent anywhere. Comes with an arrow indicator.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Single or multi-open accordion built on @radix-ui/react-accordion. Pairs with tw-animate-css's accordion-down / accordion-up keyframes for smooth height transitions.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Top-bar navigation menu with rich dropdowns, built on @radix-ui/react-navigation-menu. Includes Root, List, Item, Trigger, Content, Link, Viewport, Indicator, and a shared navigationMenuTriggerStyle for flat top-level links.

items.name: chart-area-gradient
items.title: Area Chart — Gradient
items.description: A gradient-filled area chart built on shadcn's chart primitive. Pass time-series data, get a polished result.

items.name: chart-stems
items.title: Stems Chart
items.description: Ambient time-series chart — each data point is a colored dot with a translucent vertical stem dropping to the baseline. Built on shadcn's chart primitive + Recharts (BarChart with a custom shape). Color flows through ChartConfig; gradient background, aspect ratio, dot radius, and stem opacity/width all customizable.

items.name: chart-bar-ranked
items.title: Ranked Bar Chart
items.description: Horizontal ranked bar chart with title, subtitle, and source — built on shadcn's chart primitive + Recharts (BarChart layout="vertical"). Supports currency/number/percent formatting, sort order, and value labels.

items.name: dashboard-finance
items.title: Finance Dashboard
items.description: A two-pane finance card: stacked bar chart on the left, KPI rail with icon tiles and a CTA on the right.

items.name: dashboard-net-worth
items.title: Net Worth Dashboard
items.description: Balance card with a sparkline trend and an accounts list. Each account shows a percent-change pill (green up / red down) and the current amount.

items.name: carousel-do-dont
items.title: Do/Don't Carousel
items.description: Editable LinkedIn-style comparison slide with a stop-doing-this / start-doing-this rhythm. Pass sections, get colored prompt rows.

items.name: cta-gradient
items.title: Gradient CTA Card
items.description: Dark CTA card with a checked bullet list and a full-width gradient action button. Drop in a title, bullets, and label.

items.name: cta-newsletter
items.title: Newsletter CTA
items.description: Newsletter signup with a headline, email input + subscribe button, and a decorative slot on the right. Form supports onSubmit handler or native action URL.

items.name: cta-ebook
items.title: Ebook / Report CTA
items.description: Dark CTA with an eyebrow tag, headline, description, inline email form, and a decoration slot for the book/report mockup. Accent prop picks the tag + button color from a palette.

items.name: cta-app-stack
items.title: App Stack CTA
items.description: Dark CTA with isometric 3D stack of app icons. Each layer is { bg, content } so logos can be swapped per stack. Uses CSS perspective + rotateX/Z for the iso tilt — no library needed.

items.name: featured-event
items.title: Featured Event Promo
items.description: Promo card for a webinar, summit, podcast, or any event. Brand + event-type pills, a headline, and N participant photos. Pattern overlay is a slot — pass any SVG/React node; bg color is a className.

items.name: featured-integrations
items.title: Integrations Orbit
items.description: Dashed circle with N app icons orbiting around a centered headline. Icons auto-distribute (override each angle if needed). All slots are ReactNode; uses shadcn theme tokens so light + dark auto-adapt.

items.name: featured-halftone
items.title: Halftone Photo Card
items.description: Real CMYK halftone shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) applied to any image. WebGL renders the printing-press look — channel-by-channel ink colors, dot size/softness, grain overlay, three dot styles (dots/ink/sharp). Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor) for hero copy on top of the shader.

items.name: featured-dithering
items.title: Dithering Photo Card
items.description: Image dithering shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — supports random + Bayer 2x2/4x4/8x8 patterns, custom 2-3 color palettes, configurable color steps, and an originalColors mode that samples directly from the image. Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).

items.name: featured-halftone-dots
items.title: Halftone Dots Photo Card
items.description: Single-color halftone dot shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — square or hex grids, four dot styles (classic / gooey / holes / soft), grain controls, and an originalColors mode for sampled palettes. Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).

items.name: featured-fluted-glass
items.title: Fluted Glass Photo Card
items.description: Fluted glass shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — streaked, ribbed distortions over an image with five grid shapes (lines/linesIrregular/wave/zigzag/pattern) and five distortion shapes (prism/lens/contour/cascade/flat). Looks like looking through textured architectural glass. Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).

items.name: featured-grain-gradient
items.title: Grain Gradient Card
items.description: Generative grain-gradient shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — no image input, just colors + shape. Seven shapes (wave/dots/truchet/corners/ripple/blob/sphere), up to 7 colors, animated by default. Great for hero backgrounds and OG images. Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).

items.name: featured-color-panels
items.title: Color Panels Card
items.description: Pseudo-3D color panels shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — semi-transparent slabs rotating around a central axis. Up to 7 colors, density/angle/length/fade/blur/gradient controls. Generative, animated by default. Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).

items.name: featured-mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh Gradient Card
items.description: Static mesh gradient shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — up to 10 color spots blended with two-direction sine wave distortion. Adjustable blend sharpness, grain, and positions seed. Generative, static by default (speed=0). Includes the shared title overlay API (titleText/titlePosition/titleSize/titleColor).

items.name: featured-logo-spotlight
items.title: Logo Spotlight Card
items.description: Centered logo on a mesh gradient background, wrapped in a translucent glassy halo (backdrop-blur + ring). Composes the Mesh Gradient Card as the background — all mesh props pass through; logo is any ReactNode (img, svg, monogram).

items.name: featured-story
items.title: Featured Story
items.description: Customer-story card (Stripe Customers style): brand-tinted image, customer logo, headline, and a Read story CTA. brandColor drives the duotone tint and bottom gradient; subtle hover animations on image zoom and CTA arrow.

items.name: annotated-figure
items.title: Annotated Figure
items.description: Wrap any object as children and pin labeled callouts to specific points via { x, y, side } percentages. Dashed stems extend out to the figure edges.

items.name: testimonial-video
items.title: Video Testimonial
items.description: Portrait-aspect testimonial card with a poster image, brand chip, play button, pull-quote, author, and client logo. All logos are React slots.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Sticky top navbar with brand mark, center nav using NavigationMenu (supports flat links + rich icon/description dropdowns), CTA buttons, and a scroll-aware backdrop blur. Mobile menu uses Accordion. Position prop ('fixed' | 'absolute' | 'sticky' | 'static') so you can drop it on a real page or showcase inside a card.
